title: Insurance Claim Services Supplement Rulebook
content:
## Rules

1. The claim file must be in approved status when a supplement is submitted.
2. A supplement may be submitted only no later than the supplement window after the carrier's initial approval. The supplement window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the claim file's approved date, and a supplement submitted on the last day of the window is in time.
3. A supplement may not be submitted while the file already has the tier's maximum number of supplements awaiting a carrier decision.
4. A supplement is submitted only for an amount at least the tier's supplement minimum and only for a reason the tier allows.
5. A code upgrade supplement may request no more than the ordinance or law limit less the code upgrade amounts already approved on the file, and a mold remediation supplement no more than the mold sublimit less the mold amounts already approved; when that remainder is zero the supplement is not submitted and the excess is the customer's own cost.
6. Supplements are numbered in sequence on the file starting at 1.
7. On tiers where the company does not submit supplements, the company prepares the supplement and records it on the day it is delivered to the insured or public adjuster.
8. A supplement without a carrier decision is followed up after the tier's follow-up days and escalated after the tier's number of follow-ups.

These are the rules of the Insurance Claim Services supplement desk for every supplement submitted on a claim file. The window, minimum, pending limit, allowed reasons and follow-up figures are each tier's own figures.

## Retired clause

- Rule 7, "On tiers where the company does not submit supplements, the company prepares the supplement and records it on the day it is delivered to the insured or public adjuster.", is no longer in force as written here; it has been superseded by the current Insurance Claim Services basis. Every other rule above remains in force.

## How each condition is shown

| Condition | Evidence |
|---|---|
| File in approved status | the claim file's status on the system record, before the supplement is submitted |
| Within the window | the claim file's approved date on the system record |
| Pending limit | the supplements on the file that no carrier approval yet decides |

## The window, both sides (hypothetical: a 90-day window, approval dated 2 January of a non-leap year)

| Supplement submitted on | In time? |
|---|---|
| 3 January (day 1) | yes |
| 2 April (day 90, the last day) | yes |
| 3 April (day 91) | no |

## Sublimit remainders (hypothetical figures)

- Ordinance or law limit 10000.00 with 7350.00 of code upgrade amounts already approved: a code upgrade supplement may request at most 2650.00.
- Mold sublimit 5000.00 with 5000.00 of mold amounts already approved: the remainder is zero, no mold remediation supplement is submitted and the excess is the customer's own cost.

superseded_clauses: On tiers where the company does not submit supplements, the company prepares the supplement and records it on the day it is delivered to the insured or public adjuster.
